capture_point: PDM -> CIC3 R64 gain32 signed24 -> 8-word groups -> DMA two RX slots -> validated PS copy to archive -> flush after drain -> XSDB BIN

provisional_fields.coordinates_m: Derived from user-measured 40 mm edges and user-confirmed planar square; method, tolerance and diagonals not supplied; not precision-calibrated.
provisional_fields.channel_order: User photo labels and confirmed numbered wiring; no independent per-microphone acoustic mapping test.
provisional_fields.sample_format: 24-bit exchange range, not measured effective precision.

source_provenance: Toph Beifong board operation; development data, not independent held-out validation
raw_flags: bits0..3 per-lane saturation -> H1 unknown; other bits unsupported; raw.bin retained
processing: BIN/CSV unchanged PCM integers and original IDs/flags. Existing PDM/CIC and signed24 processing remain; no extra DC removal, filtering, gain normalization, gap fill or renumbering.
limits: Diagnostic development input. No SNR gain, precision angle truth, independent validation, formal M1/H3 or closed-loop claim.

geometry_record.axis_naming_note: H1 forward/left refer to the newly defined +X/+Y axes, not the earlier colloquial front/right description.
geometry_record.coordinate_basis: Derived from four user-reported measured edges of 40 mm and explicit user confirmation of a coplanar square with microphones at the four vertices; not imported nominal CAD coordinates.

adapter_interface.mating: U1 or U2 numbered pin N to Navigator J4 numbered pin N; identify square pad 1, no mirror or 180-degree reversal
adapter_interface.shared_peripherals: J4 29/31/33/35 share CMOS_D4/CMOS_D6/CMOS_PCLK/CMOS_PWDN; no simultaneously connected camera or other driver
adapter_interface.geometry: See geometry_record: user-reported measurement and declared square; original design-only unmeasured note superseded for this dataset.
adapter_interface.evidence: EPRO2 pad nets and footprint orientation; Navigator baseboard v3.9 sheet 5; coreboard v2.5 Bank13 sheet 6 and Bank34 sheet 3; nominal VCCIO supply sheets 7/10. Not an assembly measurement.

geometry_reuse_basis: Prior operator-declared 40 mm coplanar square, not precision calibration. Current mounting confirmation is in operator record; absent means unconfirmed.

source_placement_record.operator_reported_effects: All visible effects off; same fixed WAV and volume confirmed for batch
source_placement_record.hidden_device_processing: unknown; no claim about internal limiter/AGC
source_placement_record.azimuth_convention: atan2(Y,X), +X toward mic1 from mic0, +Y toward mic3 from mic0
source_placement_record.source_position_reference: loudspeaker opening; array center, not mic0
source_placement_record.segment_operation: Independent Run; configured PS/system/processor reset and bit programming before this segment; no resets/restarts within captured segment
source_placement_record.loading_record: Operator confirms same Run entry and no reset during each segment; host binding saved separately
source_placement_record.submission_note: Operator setting/placement update 2026-09-20; filename angle remains approximate visually positioned label, not precision truth
source_placement_record.uncertainty_note: 5 cm is an operator positional estimate; axis-specific, angular and measurement uncertainty not established
